inner_loop_harness_comparison.harness_name: Inner-1: Baseline ReAct / Vibe Loop (No Skills)
inner_loop_harness_comparison.strengths: Zero setup overhead on trivial 1-file scripts.
inner_loop_harness_comparison.blind_spots: Guesses on boundary inequalities (> vs >=); weak happy-path tests.

inner_loop_harness_comparison.strengths: Eliminates context-window degradation via fresh subagent slices per task.
inner_loop_harness_comparison.blind_spots: No 2-Stage Cold Auditor, no `chmod -w` test lock, no contrastive boundary probing.

inner_loop_harness_comparison.strengths: Strong Socratic Grill, Red-Green-Refactor TDD, 4-phase debugging, and 2-stage review.
inner_loop_harness_comparison.blind_spots: Monolithic skill injection (no OOP class routing), writable test files (`chmod -w` absent), single-draft tests without `Harness^2` contrastive probing.

inner_loop_harness_comparison.strengths: OOP class hierarchy + test-time router + dynamic subclass evolution (AsyncDeadlockRemediationHarness).
inner_loop_harness_comparison.blind_spots: Lacks `Superpowers` 1-at-a-time Socratic Grill, 2-Stage Cold Auditor, and `chmod -w` test lock.

inner_loop_harness_comparison.strengths: Task-level Propose-Probe-Compose catches unseen boundary disagreements (1 probe caught at x=60).
inner_loop_harness_comparison.blind_spots: Flat prompt/tool experience bank (no OOP class tree) and no `chmod -w` anti-reward-hacking lock.

inner_loop_harness_comparison.harness_name: Inner-6: Our Unified Inner Loop (`Superpowers` x `OO-Harness` x `Harness^2`)
inner_loop_harness_comparison.strengths: Combines Superpowers TDD/Cold Auditor (`chmod -w`) + OO-Harness Subclass Router/Evolution + Harness^2 Propose-Probe-Compose.
inner_loop_harness_comparison.blind_spots: Requires Change Tiering Router (`Tier 0/1/2`) to skip probing on trivial 2-line edits.

outer_loop_sdd_framework_comparison.framework_name: Outer-1: Ephemeral Dated Docs / Task Queues (`Superpowers` Dated Docs / `GSD` / `Task-Master`)
outer_loop_sdd_framework_comparison.primary_bottleneck: 100% Spec Rot by M3: dated `YYYY-MM-DD-*.md` files and checked-off task queues never merge deltas, leaving contradictory rules and zero clean-room rebuild spec at M5.
High token overhead across 12+ role handoffs; monolithic PRD/Architecture docs lack deterministic `RENAMED -> REMOVED -> MODIFIED -> ADDED` delta merge on brownfield M3-M4 iterations.

outer_loop_sdd_framework_comparison.framework_name: Outer-3: Numbered Feature-Folder SDD (`GitHub Spec Kit` `specs/001..005/`)
outer_loop_sdd_framework_comparison.primary_bottleneck: Folder Fragmentation: creates `specs/001-m1/`, `specs/002-m2/`, `specs/003-m3/` without merging into a single per-capability spec; by M5 the agent must reconcile 5 historical folders.

outer_loop_sdd_framework_comparison.framework_name: Outer-4: In-Place EARS Spec Mode (`Amazon Kiro` `requirements.md` + `design.md` + `tasks.md`)
outer_loop_sdd_framework_comparison.primary_bottleneck: Overwrites `requirements.md` in-place without an archived change-delta audit trail (`openspec/changes/archive/`), lacks `Conductor` 4-phase Git SHA/notes logical revert at M4, and lacks an 8-section `SPEC.md` rebuild blueprint at M5.

outer_loop_sdd_framework_comparison.framework_name: Outer-5: Our Unified Outer Loop (`Conductor` + `OpenSpec` Two-Plane Delta + `SPEC.md` SSOT)
outer_loop_sdd_framework_comparison.primary_bottleneck: None across M1-M5: `OpenSpec` merges M3 deltas into `openspec/specs/`, `Conductor` reverts M4 cleanly via `git notes` & checkpoint SHAs, and 8-section `SPEC.md` passes M5 Clean-Room Rebuild in `/tmp`.
